description:
A highlight callout's Comment button saves an answer in the draft review. Use condition waits, never sleep steps. The conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} works in a git repo whose top commit, "Highlighted commit", changes src/zeta.ts (line 160 becomes "const critical = true;"), README.md and src/alpha.ts, and carries commit highlights that rank the files zeta.ts, README.md, alpha.ts and comment on src/zeta.ts line 160 ("The one line that matters.") and README.md line 3 ("Docs follow the code."). "The overlay" is the ".diff-viewer-overlay" element; "the files" are the overlay's ".diff-tree-row[aria-selected]" elements, in document order; "the second file" is the one at index 1 (pick it with "nth": 1, scoped with "within" the overlay). Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait for the message input ([data-testid="message-input"]) to be visible (allow 30s).
2. Open the Diffs workspace tool: wait for the ".header" element to be visible, then click the button with accessible name exactly "Diffs" inside ".chat-workspace-actions" (when that toolbar is not shown, click the button named exactly "More options" and then the button whose name starts with "Diffs" in ".chat-overflow-popover"). The overlay becomes visible (allow 30s).
3. Click the second file. "The callout" is the overlay's ".diff-highlight-callout-text"; it is in the viewport.
4. Comment mode marks the line under the pointer, but not over a callout, where a click doesn't comment on a line. "The hover mark" is the overlay's ".diff-viewer-line-hover". Hover the overlay's ".view-line" whose text contains "const critical = true;": there is then exactly 1 hover mark.
5. The callout lets the pointer through to the space reserved for it: move the mouse (a hover step with a "point", no hit test) to x = the callout's left + 10 and y = its top + half its height (from getBoundingClientRect()). There is then no hover mark (count 0).
6. Screen readers reach the callout and its button: "the note" is the overlay's element with role "note"; its text contains "The one line that matters.". "The button" is the note's element with role "button" and name "Comment".
7. A quiet icon with a full touch target that doesn't heighten the note: in one eval with expect "true", the button's getBoundingClientRect() width and height are exactly 24 and 24, and the note's height is within 0.5 of the height of the note's ".diff-highlight-callout-text" + 8.
8. Click the button. "The dialog" is the ".diff-viewer-comment-dialog": its text contains "Add Comment (Line 160, new)", and its ".diff-viewer-selected-text" text, with whitespace runs collapsed to single spaces and trimmed, is exactly "const critical = true; ★ The one line that matters.".
9. Fill the dialog's ".diff-viewer-comment-input" with "Why this line?" and click the dialog's button named "Save Comment". The dialog is then not visible, and the composer ([data-testid="message-input"]) is still empty.
10. Click the overlay's ".diff-draft-review-toggle". The open ".diff-draft-review[open]" has one article containing "src/zeta.ts:160 (new)" and "Why this line?". Expand its Quote details; its pre text is exactly "const critical = true;\n★ The one line that matters.".
11. Click "Send to Chat". The review and diff close. One ".message-user" contains "src/zeta.ts:160 (new)", "> const critical = true;", "> ★ The one line that matters.", and "Why this line?". The composer is still empty.

steps.expression: (() => { const direct = document.querySelector('.chat-workspace-actions button[aria-label="Diffs"]'); if (direct) { direct.click(); return 'clicked-direct'; } const more = document.querySelector('.chat-workspace-actions button[aria-label="More options"]'); if (more) { more.click(); return 'clicked-more'; } return 'not-found'; })()

(() => { const direct = document.querySelector('.chat-workspace-actions button[aria-label="Diffs"]'); if (!direct) { const popover = document.querySelector('.chat-overflow-popover button'); if (popover) { popover.click(); return 'clicked-popover'; } } return 'done'; })()

steps.point: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('.diff-viewer-overlay .diff-highlight-callout-text'); const r = c.getBoundingClientRect(); return {x: r.left + 10, y: r.top + r.height / 2}; })()

steps.expression: (() => { const note = document.querySelector('.diff-viewer-overlay [role="note"]'); const btn = note.querySelector('button[aria-label="Comment"]'); const br = btn.getBoundingClientRect(); const nr = note.getBoundingClientRect(); const calloutText = note.querySelector('.diff-highlight-callout-text'); const cr = calloutText.getBoundingClientRect(); const widthOk = Math.round(br.width) === 24; const heightOk = Math.round(br.height) === 24; const noteHeightOk = Math.abs(nr.height - (cr.height + 8)) <= 0.5; return String(widthOk && heightOk && noteHeightOk); })()
